name: Microgrid power-surplus detection block
summary: Identifies the defined condition in which available generation exceeds the assigned absorption and load capacity.
description: Identifies the defined condition in which available generation exceeds the assigned absorption and load capacity. Active-power dispatch allocates the electrical work performed by the microgrid resources. A total site target, a resource power limit and the actual measured contribution are different quantities that must be connected clearly in the diagram.

In a microgrid with solar generation, a battery and generators, the controller can allocate an import/export target among the available resources while reserving the power needed for operating disturbances. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Generation and absorption capacity” at the input and “Power-surplus indication” at the output. Surplus handling requires compatible resources.

An original control block does not supply dispatch settings, a financial operating policy or proof of grid-code compliance.
